_meta.what: Thai names players use for monsters and items. Used for on-site search, and shown on the entity page as 'เรียกอีกชื่อ'.
_meta.rule: Every entry must come from a search someone really ran, not from translating a name. Each alias records the query, how many impressions it had, and the position Google put us at, so the claim can be checked later. Two kinds appear: a Thai spelling of the English name (คาราเมล for Caramel) and a nickname for what the thing looks like or does (หมาฟ้า, 'blue dog', for Wolf; การ์ดเทเลพอต, 'teleport card', for Creamy Card, which grants Teleport).
_meta.source: Google Search Console, sc-domain:rozerothai.com, 90 days to 7 Sep 2026. Each pair is a query whose Thai text Google itself matched to that page.
_meta.regenerate: node scripts/mine-thai-aliases.mjs  (proposes new pairs from the latest Search Console data; a human confirms before they land here)
